ModMetaData.name: Gas Wall Torches [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Light your rooms with wall-mounted flames supplied by your Helixien gas network, without hauling wood to each torch Gas Wall Torches adds four distinct flames for your colony. Build them against a wall, connect them to gas and switch them manually, or let LightsOut manage them automatically Made at the request of svg FEATURES • Warm flame – a familiar torch with warm light • Bloodflame – red light that gives a nearby pawn with the active bloodfeeder gene a +2 mood thought while the torch burns • Toxflame – green light that gives a nearby pawn with the active pollution stimulus gene a +2 mood thought while the torch burns, without releasing pollution • Darkflame – true darklight for a different kind of room Each torch has a light radius of 10 tiles and consumes 0.02 Helixien gas per game tick while burning. Bloodflame and toxflame mood effects reach 7 tiles from the corresponding burning torch The flame, light, heat and sound follow the same burning state. When a torch is switched off or has no gas, it stops burning and consuming gas HOW TO USE Research Gas Extraction from Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded, then find the torches under Furniture. Each costs 15 steel. Place one against a wall in any of four directions and connect its tile to a Helixien gas pipe Use the torch's normal switch to turn it on or off. Without LightsOut, this is the way to control it With LightsOut (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2584269293) installed, the torch follows its room lighting rules on the illuminated side of the wall. Automatic shutdown also stops the flame, heat, sound and gas use; the torch lights again when LightsOut calls for it, gas is available and its manual switch is on. The manual off switch takes priority. Use LightsOut's Keep On control if you want that torch excluded from automatic shutdown COMPATIBILITY Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077), Vanilla Expanded Framework (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2023507013) and Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2877699803). Load this mod after its dependencies Bloodflame and toxflame require Biotech; darkflame requires Ideology. The warm torch is available without either DLC. English and Russian text is included LightsOut is optional. If installed, load it before Gas Wall Torches. The integration controls the torches added by this mod FEEDBACK Found a bug or an inaccuracy?
